contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ JVLIA DOMNA AVG ; R/ FELICITAS PV[BLICA]

Copper alloy with Silver wash. Coin, base Denarius of Julia Domna (193-217), Reece period 10, imitates RIC no. 551, issue of 196-211. Obverse description: Bust coiffed right. Obverse inscription: JVLIA DOMNA AVG. Reverse description: Felicitas: Female figure standing left right hand raised holding object, possibly caduceus, and leaning on pillar. Reverse inscription: FELICITAS PV[BLICA]. Cliff…
